note: Nothing in this list is mirrored into this repository. Where a file was fetched to check something, its address, its size and its SHA-256 are recorded here instead of its contents.

formulas.name: sRGB, and the transfer function and primaries used to linearise it
formulas.status: transcribed from the published definition; the white point is taken from the primaries matrix itself rather than from a rounded table, which is checked on the page (white lands on L*=100, a*=0, b*=0 exactly)

formulas.name: CIELAB
formulas.status: transcribed from the published definition; checked by two independent transcriptions, one in Python and one in JavaScript

formulas.name: CIE76 ΔE*ab
formulas.status: Euclidean distance in CIELAB; checked against the definition of a Euclidean norm and by two independent transcriptions

formulas.name: CIE94 ΔE*94, graphic-arts parameters (kL=kC=kH=1, K1=0.045, K2=0.015)
formulas.status: transcribed from the published definition. NOT checked against a published test set tonight — no such set was retrieved. It rests on two independent transcriptions and on one structural check: at a neutral reference its weights all become 1 and it must reduce exactly to CIE76, which the verifier measures over all 138030 comparisons at the palette's six neutral references.

formulas.name: CMC(l:c) at 2:1
formulas.standard: Clarke, McDonald & Rigg, Journal of the Society of Dyers and Colourists, 1984
formulas.status: transcribed from the published definition. NOT checked against a published test set tonight. It rests on two independent transcriptions. This is the weakest link in the work and is stated as such on the page and in METHOD.md.

formulas.name: CIEDE2000 ΔE00 (kL=kC=kH=1)
formulas.status: transcribed in the notation of Sharma, Wu & Dalal (2005) and checked against that paper's supplementary test data: all 34 published pairs reproduced to four decimal places, largest deviation 4.95e-05.

not_used: No published set of human colour-difference judgements was used. No formula is scored against any other, and no answer key exists in this work.
No model was called at any point in the build.
No third-party code is embedded. The licence rule of the direction of 2026-09-03 had no case to decide.
